modules.lab: Classify 18 programme activities as monitoring evaluation research audit or learning and justify ambiguous cases.
Convert a county youth-employment brief into a complete results chain and identify broken causal links.
Build a theory of change for the youth-employment case including assumptions risks mechanisms and external factors.
Translate the theory of change into a four-level logframe with means of verification and assumptions.
Draft 12 indicators and quality-assure them using SMART/CREAM tests.
Produce indicator reference sheets including numerator denominator disaggregation source frequency owner and limitations.
Calculate baselines and propose targets using trend benchmark and capacity evidence.
Assemble an operational M&E plan linking questions indicators sources frequency responsibility reporting and use.
Build a mixed data-source matrix for a maternal-health programme and defend method selection.
Calculate and justify a survey sample and select facilities/respondents using a reproducible sampling procedure.
Design pilot revise and document a digital beneficiary questionnaire.
Run completeness validity consistency timeliness integrity and precision checks and produce a DQA action log.
Clean the multi-year performance workbook and build formulas pivots validation checks and a reproducible summary sheet.
Calculate and interpret central tendency dispersion proportions trends and subgroup gaps.
Estimate confidence intervals test a programme hypothesis and write a non-technical inference statement.
Reproduce the monitoring analysis in Python with auditable transformations tables charts and interpretation.
Build a management dashboard showing targets trends geographic/sex disaggregation exceptions and data-quality warnings.
Convert analytical output into a two-page evidence brief with findings limitations actions and escalation points.
Scope a utilisation-focused evaluation and produce stakeholder and ethics matrices.
Develop OECD-DAC-aligned evaluation questions indicators methods and evidence sources.
Compare three feasible designs and write a design-selection memorandum addressing bias and validity.
Estimate programme effects from a synthetic treatment/comparison dataset and test alternative explanations.
Create a convergent mixed-methods design and triangulation matrix.
Calculate cost per outcome and conduct a simplified cost-benefit/value-for-money appraisal.
Draft an evaluation ToR quality protocol recommendation tracker and management-response matrix.
Audit an institution's MERL maturity and design its target operating model.
Cascade a strategic objective through outcomes indicators targets initiatives owners and review forums.
Design an evidence cycle connecting planning budgeting implementation reporting oversight and corrective action.
Create metadata lineage access retention privacy validation and change-control rules for an institutional MERL platform.
Map service coverage and inequality and identify spatially underserved populations.
Build validate and interpret an early-warning model for implementation underperformance.
Design an AI-assisted evidence workflow with human validation provenance bias checks and escalation controls.
Develop a learning agenda conduct an evidence review and document an adaptive-management decision.
Transform the same evidence into technical executive policy and public-facing products.

submissionRule: Every professional lab requires evidence artifact plus interpretation/reflection.
